applies_why: The judge text labels Matthew 1:20 UNDERDETERMINED because two competing senses or answers were given for that verse.
quote: D2 vs C1 (Matthew 1:20): UNDERDETERMINED -- Challenger answered the conception agency as covenant presence in [DR3] and defender answered the physical source in the womb in [CR2] and [CR3].
rule_words: That a single verse does not state a link or its contrary is never a ground for STANDS or UNDERDETERMINED, for either side. A verse that carries two senses at once is not open. Both senses stand.
room: The phrase not open and Both senses stand; readings weighed: (1) a two-sense verse cannot be treated as UNDERDETERMINED or open, because both senses stand; (2) two senses may be noted while the verse still remains UNDERDETERMINED; I adopted reading (1).
why: The judge makes two competing answers to Matthew 1:20 the basis for UNDERDETERMINED, but K-S2 says a verse with two senses is not open and both senses stand.
